caption: Sanctuary of Fortuna Primigenia, Palestrina
composition: Monumental Roman terraced sanctuary climbing a steep hillside in ramps and hemicycles · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The sanctuary's great terraced ramps climb the hillside at the center, its curved hemicycle and monumental staircases rising tier upon tier to the palace buildings at the top, with the modern town of Palestrina clustered around its base. Cypresses dot the upper slopes, and the whole structure glows pale in the 12:32 midday sun. The sheer scale of the Roman terracing, wrapping the entire hillside, is the picture's wonder.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Palestrina under midday light
